name: Risky Ruins
card_text: Whenever any player puts a Basic non-Darkness Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.

name: Switch
card_text: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

attack1: [D] Surprise Attack (30) - Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
